sql.tag.getAll: select id, tag_name, tag_type_id, font_color, company_id, bg_color, archived from flow.tag t where tag_type_id = :tagTypeId and company_id = :companyId and archived is false
sql.tag.getOne: select id, tag_name, tag_type_id, font_color, company_id, bg_color, archived from flow.tag t where id = :id and archived is false
sql.tag.update: update flow.tag t set tag_name = :tagName, bg_color = :bgColor, font_color = :fontColor, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.tag.insert: insert into flow.tag (tag_name, tag_type_id, bg_color, font_color, company_id, created_by_id) values (:tagName, :tagTypeId, :bgColor, :fontColor, :companyId, :userId)
sql.tag.delete: update flow.tag t set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :tagId
sql.tag.projectTags: select pt.id, pt.project_id, pt.tag_id, t.tag_name, t.bg_color, t.font_color, pt.archived from flow.project_tag pt inner join flow.tag t on t.id = pt.tag_id where pt.project_id = :projectId and pt.archived is false
